t: What he was saying when he woke in the night
a: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، مَاذَا أُنْزِلَ اللَّيْلَةَ مِنَ الْفِتْنَةِ، مَاذَا أُنْزِلَ مِنَ الْخَزَائِنِ، مَنْ يُوقِظُ صَوَاحِبَ الْحُجُرَاتِ
p: Lā ilāha illā-Llāh. Mādhā unzila-l-laylata mina-l-fitnah. Mādhā unzila mina-l-khazāʾin. Man yūqiẓu ṣawāḥiba-l-ḥujurāt
m: There is no god but Allah. What tribulation has been sent down tonight. What treasuries have been sent down. Who will wake the women of these rooms?
